in.title: Tempo
in.label: Tempo, beats per minute
meter.title: Time signature
meter.ftr: In eighth-note signatures the tempo counts eighths. Accents are grouped automatically (for example, 7/8 as 2+2+3); tap a beat to change it.
more.title: Metronome
adj.ftr: Tap the tempo number to type it in.
tr.ftr: The tempo rises on its own until it reaches the limit.
gap.ftr: The metronome goes quiet for a few bars, so you can check whether you keep the tempo yourself.
sig.title: Silent signals
sig.ftr: Signals follow the beats, with or without sound (the click volume can be turned down in the mixer). Vibration makes it possible to keep time with the phone in a pocket. Frequent flashes may be unpleasant for people with photosensitivity.
sig.android: Flashlight and vibration are available in the Android app on devices that have them.
monoFixed: In Minimal the view is fixed: {v}.
